text_block_list.text: The final day of the summer training camp…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Trainer?! Wasn't it 
brilliantly fast!?
choice_data_list: That speed in the sand is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I think I've improved quite a bit at this 
training camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She was fast to begin with, but now she's 
even faster! Truly a Bakushin-worthy 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is as good as a promise! Victory in 
the Sprinter's Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win by a landslide, I'll change 
my name to Sakura O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will! That's the only way to 
win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to it, as a sort of 
spectator!

…This is how the, hot? summer training 
camp with Sakura Bakushin O came to an 
end.
